_comment: Generic, read-only Cowork prompts safe for any MCAPS Israel employee. No PII, no role-specific details, no send/schedule actions. Cowork will catch up, summarize, research, draft. Add/remove freely.
prompts: Catch me up on what I missed today.
Give me a daily briefing for today.
Summarize my unread emails from the last 24 hours and highlight anything urgent.
What are my top priorities for tomorrow based on my calendar and inbox?
Organize my inbox and surface anything that needs a reply today.
Prep me for my next meeting — pull the relevant context, attendees, and any related files.
Summarize this week's emails grouped by topic.
What action items do I have outstanding from recent conversations?
Find emails from internal stakeholders I haven't replied to yet.
Summarize the chats I've been mentioned in over the last two days.
What meetings do I have tomorrow, and what should I prepare for each?
Help me organize my week — show my schedule and call out gaps or back-to-backs.
Find documents shared with me this week that I haven't opened yet.
Summarize the documents I worked on this week.
What follow-ups are still pending from my recent meetings?
Are there any meetings on my calendar that look like duplicates or that I could decline?
Show me the most recent customer-related emails in my inbox and summarize them.
Research the latest Azure AI announcements from the last seven days.
Research recent news about Microsoft's competitive position in cloud and AI.
Summarize the latest Microsoft 365 release notes that are relevant to a field role.
Prepare a brief on industry trends in generative AI from this week.
Catch me up on internal Microsoft announcements from the last few days.
Find any files in my OneDrive related to Q2 planning and summarize them.
Summarize my recent SharePoint and OneDrive activity.
Research a public company by name and prepare a one-page brief — pick a Microsoft customer in EMEA.
Draft a short status update for my manager covering this week's highlights, blockers, and next steps. Don't send it — leave it as a draft.
Draft a one-page summary of a recent customer conversation I had this week. Don't send.
Create a draft agenda for an internal team sync — generic structure I can reuse.
Summarize today's calendar and highlight anything I should prep for in the next two hours.
What outstanding requests do I have from colleagues across email and Teams?
Summarize my last week of activity into three bullet points I could share at a 1:1.
Find and summarize the most recent product documentation updates for Microsoft Fabric.
Find and summarize the most recent updates for Microsoft Copilot Studio.
Catch me up on any conversations about pipeline, opportunities, or customer escalations from this week.
Draft talking points for a generic internal weekly review meeting based on this week's activity. Don't send.
